subject.title: feat: keep main agents aware of group activity

question: Should OpenClaw permit implicit, durable main-session read access to same-agent group sessions under `tools.sessions.visibility="tree"` once every ingress reliably carries the effective binding `dmScope`?
rationale: This is a new implicit session-visibility policy with durable provenance; repository labels and the changed access boundary indicate that maintainer intent is required beyond mechanically fixing missing scope propagation.

options.title: Confirm the ambient visibility policy after repair
options.body: Preserve the queue-only, same-agent, read-only design, require complete ingress propagation and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in instead
options.body: Avoid implicit main-session group visibility by introducing an explicit product policy only if maintainers decide the added operator control outweighs configuration-surface cost.

recommendation.title: Confirm the ambient visibility policy after repair
recommendation.body: Preserve the queue-only, same-agent, read-only design, require complete ingress propagation and real behavior proof before merge.
